examples.en: Daniel treated one difficult question as a lion in the way and delayed the whole exercise.
examples.zh: Daniel 把一道較難的題目視為無法跨越的障礙，結果把整份練習也拖延了。

meaning.en: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.
meaning.zh: 指一個想像出來、被誇大的，或其實可以克服的困難或危險；當事人把它當作不行動、拖延或放棄的理由。
naturalZh: 指一個想像出來、被誇大的，或其實可以克服的困難或危險
當事人把它當作不行動、拖延或放棄的理由。

register.summaryEn: For this lesson, treat the expression as literary, biblical and deliberately old-fashioned. It is suitable for reflective writing, stories, speeches, sermons, literary discussion and humorous or serious criticism. It is not a routine expression for ordinary service emails, formal reports or everyday small talk.
register.summaryZh: 本課把這個表達視為帶有文學、《聖經》及古雅色彩的說法。 它適合用於反思文章、故事、演說、 講道、文學討論，以及帶批評意味的幽默或嚴肅評論。 它並不是一般客服電郵、正式報告或日常閒談中的常用說法。

benefits.en: He treated the small problem as a lion in the way.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以把「把小問題誇大成不能行動的理由」濃縮成一個鮮明短語。

benefits.titleEn: It Separates Real Danger from Self-Created Fear
benefits.titleZh: 區分真正危險與自行製造的恐懼
benefits.en: It can contrast a genuine barrier with an obstacle that somebody has imagined or exaggerated.
benefits.zh: 它可以對比真正障礙與當事人自行想像或誇大的困難。

benefits.titleEn: It Creates a Memorable Visual Metaphor
benefits.titleZh: 形成容易記憶的鮮明比喻
benefits.en: The picture of a lion blocking the road helps readers remember the idea of exaggerating an obstacle and refusing to act.
benefits.zh: 獅子擋路的畫面十分鮮明，有助讀者記住「誇大障礙、藉故不行動」的意思。

benefits.titleEn: It Supports Literary and Biblical Understanding
benefits.titleZh: 幫助理解文學及《聖經》用語
benefits.en: Students may meet this image in older writing, religious texts, speeches and literary discussion.
benefits.zh: 學生可能會在較古老的文章、宗教文本、演說及文學討論中遇到這個意象。

benefits.en: “Is this a real barrier, or have I made it a lion in the way?” The idiom is not automatically better than plain English. In ordinary modern conversation, an imagined obstacle, an exaggerated problem or an excuse may be clearer.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以幫助人反思： 慣用語並非必然比直接說法更好。 在一般現代對話中，an imagined obstacle、an exaggerated problem 或 an excuse 可能更清楚。

origin.statusEn: Well-Documented Biblical Wording; Exact Later Development Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 有充分記錄的《聖經》用語；後來的確切演變過程不明

history.en: The wording a lion in the way appears in Proverbs 26:13 in the King James Version. Proverbs 22:13 contains a closely related excuse involving a lion outside. The first edition of the King James Bible was printed in 1611; however, 1611 is the date of this English translation, not the invention of the much older proverb.
history.zh: 這個說法見於《英王欽定本聖經》的《箴言》26章13節。 《箴言》22章13節亦出現非常相近的藉口，提到外面有獅子。 《英王欽定本聖經》第一版於1611年印行； 不過，1611年只是這個英文譯本的出版年份，並不是這句古老箴言被創造的年份。

history.en: Traditional commentary explains the lion as a danger imagined or pretended by a person who wants to avoid work. This interpretation provides the bridge to the wider figurative use: a frightening obstacle that exists mainly in the person’s mind or has been greatly exaggerated.
history.zh: 傳統註釋把這隻獅子解釋為一個人為了逃避工作而想像或假裝存在的危險。 這種解釋形成了通往較廣泛比喻用法的語意橋樑：一個主要存在於當事人心中，或被大幅誇大的可怕障礙。

origin.memoryEn: An imagined lion makes the road look impossible; an exaggerated problem makes action look impossible.
origin.memoryZh: 想像中的獅子令人覺得道路無法通過；被誇大的問題令人覺得行動無法開始。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：只使用比喻意思
rules.en: This is literal and is not the target meaning.
rules.zh: 孩子在路上看見真正的獅子，屬於字面意思，並不是本課目標。

rules.titleEn: The Obstacle Should Be Imagined, Exaggerated or Avoidable
rules.titleZh: 規則二：障礙應是想像出來、被誇大或可以克服的
rules.en: A slightly difficult form, one possible mistake or a little rain may become a lion in the way when somebody uses it as an excuse not to act.
rules.zh: 當某人把一份稍為困難的表格、一個可能出現的錯誤或一點小雨用作不行動的藉口時，這些小問題便可能成為 a lion in the way。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for Genuine Serious Danger
rules.titleZh: 規則三：不要用於真正而嚴重的危險
rules.en: A fire blocking an exit is a real emergency, not a lion in the way.
rules.zh: 火災阻塞出口是真正的緊急情況，不應被形容為被誇大的藉口。

rules.titleZh: 規則四：保留時態、情態及確定程度
rules.en: may become ≠ became could be ≠ was
rules.zh: 必須保留原句的時態、可能性及確定程度。

rules.titleZh: 規則五：保留具有獨立意思的資料
rules.en: Preserve the person, obstacle and result when they carry information not already expressed by the idiom.
rules.zh: 如果人物、障礙或結果包含目標慣用語尚未表達的資料，便必須保留。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Same Meaning Unnecessarily
rules.titleZh: 規則六：不要不必要地重複相同意思
rules.en: Once the answer uses a lion in the way, do not immediately add another clause that merely repeats that a small problem stopped somebody from acting, unless the result is essential.
rules.zh: 使用目標表達後，不要立即再用另一分句重複「小問題阻止某人行動」的相同意思，除非該結果是必須保留的獨立資料。

rules.titleZh: 規則七：使用完全相同的單數形式
rules.zh: 本練習的每個答案都必須使用完全相同的單數形式。

rules.titleEn: Translate the Meaning, Not the Animal Image
rules.titleZh: 規則八：翻譯實際意思，不要翻譯動物畫面
rules.zh: 攔路虎； 被誇大的障礙； 想像中的困難； 用來拖延的藉口； 自行製造的不行動理由

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using a lion in the way. Preserve the original person, obstacle, tense, certainty and important result. Use the exact target phrase in every answer.
instructions.zh: 使用 a lion in the way 改寫句子或完成回應。 保留原句的人物、障礙、時態、確定程度及重要結果。 每題答案都必須使用完全相同的目標短語。

questions.prompt: Daniel thought that one difficult question made the whole exercise impossible, so he delayed all of it.
questions.promptZh: Daniel 覺得一道較難的題目令整份練習變得不可能完成，因此把全部內容也拖延了。
questions.answer: Daniel treated one difficult question as a lion in the way and delayed the whole exercise.
questions.answerZh: Daniel 把一道較難的題目視為無法跨越的障礙，結果把整份練習也拖延了。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Chloe refused to take a short walk because there might be a little rain.
questions.promptZh: Chloe 因為可能會下少量雨，便拒絕去作短程散步。
questions.answer: To Chloe, a little rain was a lion in the way, so she refused to take the short walk.
questions.answerZh: 對 Chloe 來說，一點小雨竟成了不去散步的藉口，所以她拒絕前往。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Ethan saw one word he did not know and decided not to read the page at all.
questions.promptZh: Ethan 看見一個不認識的字，便決定整頁也不讀。
questions.answer: Ethan turned one unfamiliar word into a lion in the way and did not read the page.
questions.answerZh: Ethan 把一個不熟悉的字當成攔路虎，因而沒有閱讀整頁。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Sophie could not find a pen, so she put off her homework for an hour.
questions.promptZh: Sophie 找不到筆，所以把功課拖延了一小時。
questions.answer: A missing pen became a lion in the way, and Sophie put off her homework for an hour.
questions.answerZh: 找不到筆竟成了 Sophie 的攔路虎，她把功課拖延了一小時。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Leo did not send his club application because the short form looked slightly difficult.
questions.promptZh: Leo 因為那份簡短表格看來有點困難，便沒有遞交社團申請。
questions.answer: Leo turned the short form into a lion in the way and did not send his club application.
questions.answerZh: Leo 把那份簡短表格誇大成無法克服的障礙，結果沒有遞交社團申請。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Grace was so afraid of making one possible mistake that she would not speak in class.
questions.promptZh: Grace 太害怕可能犯一個錯誤，因此不肯在課堂上發言。
questions.answer: For Grace, one possible mistake was a lion in the way, so she would not speak in class.
questions.answerZh: 對 Grace 來說，一個可能出現的錯誤竟成了攔路虎，所以她不肯在課堂上發言。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Whenever Noah was asked to begin a simple task, he found some small reason not to start.
questions.promptZh: 每當 Noah 被要求開始一項簡單工作時，他總會找出一個小理由不開始。
questions.answer: Noah found a lion in the way whenever he was asked to begin a simple task.
questions.answerZh: 每當 Noah 被要求開始一項簡單工作時，他總會找出一個被誇大的障礙作為藉口。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Hannah kept delaying a five-minute phone call because it felt much more difficult than it really was.
questions.promptZh: Hannah 不斷拖延一通只需五分鐘的電話，因為她把它想像得比實際困難得多。
questions.answer: The five-minute phone call looked like a lion in the way to Hannah, who kept delaying it.
questions.answerZh: 那通五分鐘的電話在 Hannah 眼中彷彿成了巨大障礙，令她不斷拖延。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Oliver claimed that tidying his small room was almost impossible, but he simply did not want to do it.
questions.promptZh: Oliver 聲稱整理自己的小房間幾乎是不可能的，但其實他只是不想做。
questions.answer: Oliver acted as if there was a lion in the way, but he simply did not want to tidy his room.
questions.answerZh: Oliver 表現得像有巨大障礙擋路一樣，但其實他只是不想整理房間。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Ava gave up on the course because of a small fee before she even asked whether help was available.
questions.promptZh: Ava 因為一筆小額費用而放棄課程，甚至沒有先詢問是否可以獲得協助。
questions.answer: Ava treated a small fee as a lion in the way and gave up on the course before asking for help.
questions.answerZh: Ava 把一筆小額費用視為攔路虎，還未求助便放棄了課程。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Whenever the team has a task, Ben points to one small problem so that he can avoid the extra work.
questions.promptZh: 每當團隊有工作時，Ben 都會指出一個小問題，藉此避開額外工作。
questions.answer: Ben always sees a lion in the way when a task requires a little extra effort.
questions.answerZh: 每當一項工作需要多一點努力時，Ben 總會把小問題看成無法跨越的障礙。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Priya did not start because the first step was not perfectly clear, although she could have asked for help.
questions.promptZh: Priya 因為第一步並非完全清楚而沒有開始，儘管她本可以求助。
questions.answer: Priya saw a lion in the way because the first step was not perfectly clear, although she could have asked for help.
questions.answerZh: Priya 因第一步不夠清楚而把它視為巨大障礙，儘管她本可以求助。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Marcus says he cannot finish the online task because the internet signal is sometimes weak, but he could use the library computer.
questions.promptZh: Marcus 說網絡訊號有時較弱，所以無法完成網上工作，但他其實可以使用圖書館的電腦。
questions.answer: The weak internet signal has become a lion in the way for Marcus, although he could use the library computer.
questions.answerZh: 網絡訊號較弱已被 Marcus 當成攔路虎，儘管他可以使用圖書館的電腦。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Before Isla sent the message, she worried about one small spelling error until it seemed like a huge reason to stop.
questions.promptZh: Isla 發出訊息前，一直擔心一個小小的拼字錯誤，最後更把它視為不能繼續的重大理由。
questions.answer: One small spelling error had become a lion in the way before Isla sent the message.
questions.answerZh: Isla 發出訊息前，一個小小的拼字錯誤已被她看成巨大障礙。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: If we cancel the picnic only because light rain is possible, we will be using a small risk as an excuse.
questions.promptZh: 如果我們只因可能有小雨便取消野餐，就等於把一個小風險當成藉口。
questions.answer: The chance of light rain may become a lion in the way if we keep looking for excuses.
questions.answerZh: 如果我們不斷尋找藉口，小雨的可能性也可能變成攔路虎。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: The event matters to you, so a long bus ride should not stop you from going.
questions.promptZh: 這項活動對你很重要，所以較長的巴士車程不應阻止你前往。
questions.answer: The long bus ride should not become a lion in the way when the event matters to you.
questions.answerZh: 既然這項活動對你很重要，較長的巴士車程就不應成為攔路虎。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: A: Everyone is busy on Tuesday afternoon. Should we cancel the whole project? B: No. One busy afternoon should not stop everything.
questions.promptZh: 甲：星期二下午人人都很忙。我們應否取消整個項目？ 乙：不應該。一個繁忙的下午不應令所有事情停下來。
questions.answer: We must not treat one busy afternoon as a lion in the way and cancel the whole project.
questions.answerZh: 我們絕不能把一個繁忙的下午當成攔路虎，因而取消整個項目。
questions.targetMeaning: An imagined, exaggerated or avoidable danger or obstacle that somebody uses as a reason not to act.

questions.prompt: Is the short application form really such a serious obstacle, or are you only nervous about applying?
questions.promptZh: 這份簡短申請表真的構成如此嚴重的障礙，還是你只是對申請感到緊張？
questions.answer: Could the short form really be a lion in the way, or are you simply nervous about applying?
